Every scrcpy option in one place. Choices are saved for next time.
Tap a group to open it. Empty fields use the scrcpy default.
Turn on ADB over Wi-Fi on this phone so another phone or a computer can mirror and control it at this phone\'s IP address, port 5555.

Root is needed to do this from the phone

%1$s

Android only lets an app switch ADB to port 5555 with root. Without root, do it once from a computer (it stays on until the phone restarts):

1. Settings › About phone › tap Build number 7 times.
2. Developer options › turn on USB debugging.
3. Connect the phone by USB and run:
 adb tcpip 5555

Then tap Check here.

Something not working? The connection log shows every step and what the other device answered. The app log is this app\'s own system log. No root needed.

Bundled upstream server: v5.0.1. Audio needs Android 11 or newer on the target device. Desktop-only flags (recording, window settings, USB/OTG, HID keyboard/mouse) are not part of this Android viewer.
